function driftExceeded(threshold, baseline, candidate){

}
```

- What metrics distinguish benign performance change from drift-induced degradation?

// Simple drift-detection helper (illustrative)
function driftDetected(scores, baselineMean, threshold = 0.1) {
  const mean = scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length;
  return Math.abs(mean - baselineMean) > threshold;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you implement adaptive drift thresholds in production?
- What metrics would you collect to validate 100ms latency under burst traffic?
- How would you ensure PII never lands in logs during alerting?

- Mock external dependencies
- Target 80%+ code coverage

### Integration Testing
- Validate service boundaries
- Test database interactions
- Verify message queue flows

### Contract Testing
- Consumer-driven contracts with Pact
- Prevent breaking changes
- Automated verification in CI

### Performance Testing
- Load testing with k6
- Stress testing scenarios
- Capacity planning benchmarks

### Chaos Engineering
- Simulate failures with Gremlin
- Test recovery mechanisms
- Improve system resilience

## CI/CD Optimization

- Parallel test execution
- Test result caching
- Smart test selection based on code changes
- Comprehensive monitoring and alerting
